settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Store name, currency, stock levels, notifications, and barcode labels.

form.readOnlyHint: You can view settings only. Ask an admin to make changes.
form.currencyHint: Currency is fixed for now and can't be changed here yet.
form.defaultCountryCodeHint: Used to prefill new phone numbers.
form.lowStockThresholdHint: Products at or below this quantity are flagged as low stock.
form.saleNotificationsIntro: Every sale made by a manager or an employee sends a notification to the admins' phones. Nobody is notified of their own sale.
form.saleNotificationModeHint: More options are coming later, such as sales above a set amount or a periodic summary.
form.labelsIntro: How barcode labels come out of your printer. The Labels screen uses these numbers every time it prints.
form.labelPrintModeHintThermal: Each label prints on its own page, so the page is the label. Choose this for a label (roll) printer.
form.labelPrintModeHintA4Grid: Labels print in rows and columns on one A4 page. Fill in the sheet layout below so it matches your sticker paper.
form.labelSizeHint: Measure one sticker in millimetres. Between {min} and {max}.
form.labelSheetIntro: Measure your sticker sheet once, then these numbers are used for every print.
form.labelGridHint: How many stickers the sheet has across and down. Between {min} and {max}.
form.labelMarginsHint: The blank space between the edge of the paper and the first sticker. Type 0 if the stickers start right at the edge.
form.labelGapsHint: The gap between one sticker and the next. Type 0 if they touch each other.
form.labelSheetErrorHint: Some A4 sheet numbers aren't valid. Switch the printer type back to the A4 sheet to fix them.

notifications.title: Notifications on this device
notifications.intro: Turn notifications on to hear about sales on this phone as they happen. This setting applies to this device only.

state.on: Notifications are on for this device.
state.off: Notifications are off for this device.

blocked.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Try another browser or another phone.
blocked.needs-install: On iPhone and iPad, add the app to the Home Screen first: tap the share button, choose “Add to Home Screen”, then open the app from its icon and turn notifications on here.
blocked.not-configured: Notifications aren't set up on the server yet. Ask whoever runs the server.
blocked.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser or phone settings, then try again.

notifications.failed: Couldn't change the notification setting. Please try again.
notifications.iosHint: iPhone and iPad note: notifications only arrive once the app has been added to the Home Screen and opened from its icon.
